commit_msg: Record the deployment and the two silent compose faults
overall_why: No route from customer intent to payment exists.
constraint: The business cannot accept money. Checkout is staged and there is no payment processor anywhere in the site. All 14 forms now hand off to email by hand, which keeps a visitor's intent but stores nothing and builds no list. And 6s-success.com still serves a parked page, so none of it is reachable. Nothing else moves revenue until these do.
